segments.text: ANY PERSON CAN REMOVE ANY NEGATIVITY WHICH IS BELOW HIS OR HER DIMENSION
Here comes the concept of dimension, ancient but still relevant.
It is a place where an individual stands in astral world.
For example: If a person has X dimension then that person could access energies which are equivalent or below that particular dimension.
So, a person can see negativities which is lower than the person’s dimension, Energies greater than the person dimension would not be seen or identified.
So here comes a big loophole…
Any person can see or can remove any energy which is lower than his dimension.
All the above energies are invisible and inevitable to him.

To fulfill that void bhaiya himself does checks aura of ashaeyein aspirant since our gurutattava is the energy who stands with him which makes him accurate most of the time. Since gurutattava himself is upgrading dimension continuously therefore, more than 95% of negativities gets detected & can be removed later.
NOTE: If a person has very strong aura then that person would be only affected by very high dimensions negativities.

In Ashayein , mantra chanting is the foundation of all spiritual practices. It not only awakens an aspirant’s inner energy but also helps them learn powerful spiritual techniques. Through Mantra Shakti , an aspirant gain the ability to protect himself from negative energies, including harmful tantrik kriyas like Maran (destructive energy), Stambhan (blocking progress), Uchattan (causing distractions), Bhedan (creating confusion), and Videshan (causing division). By continuously chanting and staying connected to Mantra Raj Sarkar , the aspirant gains both spiritual power and divine protection.
Relation Of Mantra Jaap With Dimension

Mantra jaap with gurutattava helps a person to reach higher dimension, so if a person chants mantra regularly his dimension will increase simultaneously. So whenever an aspirant starts mantra jaap then the mantrashakti of that person creates a path upwards & that same mantra shakti takes the Kundalini shakti upwards through that path.
Attacks While Dimension Increases
One thing which everyone should know here that, when a person chants mantra regularly
dimension continuously increases.

When a person moves from one dimension to another, has to go through all the energies present in that particular dimension, thus gets attacked multiple times which is inevitable. Everyone has to go through this.
Why Kalyan Lok Is Made
Case study: Suppose a person A has mantra shakti and know vidyas to remove negativity, so he made profession out of it.

He used to remove the negativity of person’s who came to him & people got relief. But after a certain period of time due to continuous removing of negativities from people, all the negativities which were removed from the body stayed with that person, as the number of negativities increases the intensity of negative tattva increases. Thus, her ability & shakti was intruded & affected his family life and family members. At last, he was so frustrated that he had to close his profession. Now he was one of the victims with multiple negativities.
To make sure this won’t happen our Gurudev has assigned a lok to ashaeiynn commonly known as Kalyan lok where all the negative energies & pitra are sent.
How Kalyan Lok Is Made
A lok authorised by gurudev and validated by 11 devi & devtas came into existence.

It is connected to Pretraj Sarkar which is an authorized lok in Mehendipur balaji. Here all the negativities including malin pitra and malin dev tattva are sent, where they go through a specified process after which they are sent to Pretraj Sarkar.
Kalyan Lok works as a bridge between Ashaeiynn & Pretraj Sarkar.
It has 16 different subsections or lokas based on different functioning that is torturing, cleaning, teaching, & the final step where they are send to next yoni.

NOTE: For the continuous working of Kalyan lok, it demands a high amount of continuous energy which is given by our Gurudev and 11 devi & devtas. Ashaeiynn also tries to compensate that energy by chanting, sadhnas, homa or havan on a continuous basis.
Can I Send Negativity To Kalyan Lok?

In ashaeiynn aspirant who chants “Jai Siya Ram” regularly more than 2 hours daily, is able to send the negativity or pitra to Kalyan lok using negativity or pitra prayer given by ashaeiynn & hence people are themselves able to remove their negativities.
